comments.body: The `pre-commit` check is red on the `ty` hook, but that's pre-existing on `main` — commit `0d1862e` (current `main` HEAD) fails the same job, on `fenn/experimental/vision/normalize.py` and `fenn/logging.py`, neither of which this PR touches. `ruff check`, `ruff format` and `typos` pass, and all four `test (3.11–3.14)` jobs are green.
